system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Calculates the insurance premium for an enrolled PMFBY policy. For your information, my policy_id is None.

function.name: pmfby_calculate_premium
function.description: Calculates the insurance premium for an enrolled PMFBY policy. Returns total premium, farmer's share, and government subsidy breakdown. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT collect payment — use pmfby_pay_premium. Fails if policy_status is not 'enrolled' or policy_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance policy.
